text: You're a soldier in Western Australia in nineteen thirty two, and your enemy is twenty thousand emus.
They're stomping through the wheat on farms owned by men who fought in World War One.
So the army sends Major Meredith, two machine guns and ten thousand bullets.
On day one, the emus split up into tiny groups and run out of range.
Two days later, more than a thousand emus walk right up to a dam. It's the perfect ambush.
Then the gun jams, and the whole flock scatters.
So they put a gun on a truck. But the emus outrun it, and the ride is so bumpy the gunner can't fire a single shot.
After six days, the army pulls out.
Major Meredith said the emus could face machine guns like tanks.
The army came back for a month and still couldn't win. Farmers went back to collecting bounties.
Share this with someone who would lose to an emu, and subscribe for more true stories.
